intervention: CARRICK_HVF_SYSCALL_TRANSPORT=mailbox vs legacy, same image and binary; legacy retains mailbox publication and additionally reads registers, so this measures register decoding cost and does not remove mailbox or HVF exits
design: one warmup per mode, two ABBA blocks; exact queue-state assertions per sample, 21 internal samples, original LTP separately; all runs and failures retained
acceptance: no product change from frequency or synthetic control alone
source_evidence: Runtime source snapshot and signed identity from previous inotify-lifecycle artifact; no relink this turn
independent_units: Each fresh Carrick invocation runs watch-controls and watch-states as two sequential guest processes. 21 samples per phase within a process are not independent launches.
legacy_intervention: Both arms publish and consume the mailbox; legacy adds 9 GPR reads, 4 sysreg reads and 1 GPR result write per ordinary syscall, qualified live at 169 add and 169 remove requests per arm.
default_transport: HvfSyscallTransport::parse(None) is Mailbox, source checked; no default changed
trace_launch_failure: Initial worktree binary path required a sudo password. Retried using byte-identical binary in the existing NOPASSWD Carrick diagnostic directory. No privilege configuration changed.
formal_acceptance: Diagnostic screen only. No new performance candidate, signed timing contract acceptance, or smoke/full promotion. Existing CLI probe evidence belongs to unchanged lifecycle artifact.
remaining_runtime_gap: Invalid pair raw Linux ratio exceeds 10x; near-parity and 2x remain unachieved.
